metadata.name: solmix
metadata.description: Shielded pool for SOL, stablecoins and tokenized stocks on Solana

instructions.name: add_sol_asset
docs: Lists native SOL with the given deposit sizes (lamports).

instructions.name: add_token_asset
docs: Lists an SPL / Token-2022 mint and creates the pool's vault for it.

instructions.name: buy_cancel
docs: Unwinds a buy: the input goes to the destination wallet instead.

accounts.name: destination_token_in
docs: Token input only: the destination's account for the input asset (create it idempotently beforehand).

instructions.name: buy_execute
docs: Runs the aggregator route; at least min_out must reach the destination.

accounts.name: vault_in
docs: Pool vault for the input asset (token assets only): receives whatever the route didn't spend.

accounts.name: destination_token
docs: The destination's token account for the bought token (create it idempotently beforehand).

accounts.name: order_token_out
docs: The order's own account for the bought token, when the route references it. Anything the
route leaves there is swept to the destination, then it is closed (rent to the relayer).

instructions.name: buy_open
docs: Spends notes into a buy order for any routable token, delivered to `terms.destination`.

accounts.name: vault_in
docs: Pool vault for the input asset (token assets only).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Creates the pool (Merkle tree + admin) and funds the SOL vault's rent.

instructions.name: set_asset
docs: Changes deposit sizes and/or pauses deposits. Withdrawals are never affected.

instructions.name: swap_cancel
docs: Unwinds an order; if it was opened, the refund notes are credited.

instructions.name: swap_commit_out
docs: Proves the output notes (deposit-shaped proof over the output asset, worth min_out).

instructions.name: swap_execute
docs: Runs the aggregator route and credits the output notes.

accounts.name: vault_in
docs: Pool vault for the input asset (token assets only): receives whatever the route didn't spend.

accounts.name: vault_out
docs: Pool vault for the output asset (token assets only): receives min_out.

accounts.name: relayer_out_account
docs: When buying SOL the surplus reaches the relayer through the order's close instead.

instructions.name: swap_open
docs: Spends the user's notes into the order's escrow; the proof binds the order's terms.

accounts.name: vault_in
docs: Pool vault for the input asset (token assets only).

instructions.name: swap_prepare
docs: Creates a swap order and proves its refund notes (deposit-shaped proof over the input asset).

instructions.name: transact
docs: Deposit (ext_amount > 0), withdraw (< 0) or private merge/split (= 0).

accounts.name: signer
docs: Pays fees and nullifier rent. The depositor for deposits; a relayer or anyone for withdrawals.

accounts.name: depositor_token
docs: Source of a token deposit, owned by `signer`.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the pool admin can do this

errors.name: InvalidProof
errors.msg: Proof is malformed or does not verify

errors.name: InvalidEncryptedOutput
errors.msg: Encrypted outputs must be 68 bytes each

errors.name: InvalidAmount
errors.msg: Amount out of range

errors.name: DuplicateNullifier
errors.msg: Both inputs use the same nullifier

errors.name: FieldOverflow
errors.msg: Value is not a valid field element

errors.name: UnknownRoot
errors.msg: Merkle root is not in the recent history

errors.name: DepositsPaused
errors.msg: Deposits of this asset are paused

errors.name: InvalidDenomination
errors.msg: Amount is not an allowed deposit size for this asset

errors.name: FeeOnDeposit
errors.msg: Deposits cannot carry a relayer fee

errors.name: MissingTokenAccounts
errors.msg: Token assets need mint, vault and token program accounts

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: Mint does not match the asset

errors.name: WrongVault
errors.msg: Vault is not the pool's token account for this mint

errors.name: TransferFeeNotSupported
errors.msg: Token charged a transfer fee; this asset is not supported

errors.name: TreeFull
errors.msg: Merkle tree is full

errors.name: PoseidonFailed
errors.msg: Poseidon hash failed

errors.name: SwapExpired
errors.msg: Swap deadline has passed

errors.name: SwapSameAsset
errors.msg: Cannot swap an asset for itself

errors.name: SwapState
errors.msg: Swap order is not in the right state for this step

errors.name: SwapUnderfilled
errors.msg: Swap returned less than the minimum

errors.name: WrongSwapProgram
errors.msg: Swap program is not the whitelisted aggregator

errors.name: ForbiddenRouteAccount
errors.msg: Swap route may not touch pool accounts

fields.name: mint
docs: Pubkey::default() for native SOL.

fields.name: gas
docs: Extra lamports (SOL input only) handed to the destination so it can pay fees later.

types.name: Nullifier
docs: Exists only to mark a nullifier as spent; creating it twice fails.

types.name: SwapOrder
docs: One swap. Seeded by a random id chosen by the user's client.

fields.name: opened
docs: swap_open ran: amount_in sits in the escrow.
